variants.headline: The {{partner}} route balance
body: At turn {{tradeToTurn}}, routes to {{partnerLink}} brought {{gold}} gold per turn, or {{share}}% of positive gold from our outgoing foreign routes. The earlier share was {{previousShare}}% at turn {{tradeFromTurn}}.
The trade screen shows the connections behind these figures. Review the route mix when weighing the benefits of another connection with this partner.

variants.headline: Merchant routes redraw the balance
body: {{partnerLink}} accounted for {{share}}% of our positive outgoing foreign-route gold at turn {{tradeToTurn}}, compared with {{previousShare}}% at turn {{tradeFromTurn}}.
The routes supplied {{gold}} gold per turn in the later observation. Review the route mix when considering future connections.

variants.headline: Merchants and envoys look toward {{partner}}
body: Routes to {{partnerLink}} accounted for {{share}}% of positive outgoing foreign-route gold at turn {{tradeToTurn}}, compared with {{previousShare}}% at turn {{tradeFromTurn}}. A deal with the same partner was recorded at turn {{eventTurn}}.
Merchants and envoys both have business with this partner. Consider the route balance alongside the exchange when reviewing the relationship.

variants.headline: Two views of {{partner}}
body: Routes to {{partnerLink}} supplied {{share}}% of positive outgoing foreign-route gold at turn {{tradeToTurn}}. Cultural output there changed from {{previousCulture}} per turn at turn {{cultureFromTurn}} to {{culture}} at turn {{cultureToTurn}}.
The routes keep this neighbor in the merchant account; its changing cultural output gives the wider world another reason to pay attention. Follow both measures in later dispatches.

variants.headline: A new route partner: {{partner}}
body: Our outgoing foreign routes now include {{partnerLink}}, absent from the complete earlier route observation at turn {{fromTurn}}. The new observation is dated turn {{toTurn}}.

variants.headline: Foreign trade contracts
body: Between turns {{fromTurn}} and {{toTurn}}, our outgoing foreign route count changed from {{previousRoutes}} to {{routes}}, and its positive gold yield from {{previousGold}} to {{gold}} per turn.

variants.headline: Plundering strikes our commerce
body: During turns {{fromTurn}} to {{toTurn}}, {{plunderEvents}} route plundering events affecting our commerce were recorded. Total recorded plunder gold: {{plunderGold}}. Review the trade overview when replacing connections.
